text:
marta_l: FYI telemetry alerted: canary bucket showing p95 spike and 1 OOM after rolling engine-bundle-2026-05-qx3 to 1% in night pool.

ryan_c: which night pool and what's the deploy id?

marta_l: us-west-night-3, deploy id `2026-05-qx3-matmul-slab`. spike started ~00:46.

ryan_c: slab reclaim code landed in that bundle. did we flip the aggressive reclaim flag?

marta_l: yes it's enabled by default in the bundle. seems fine on short seq but long tail >6k shows memory climb.

release-coordinator: options: pause rollouts, pin back to previous stable, or toggle remote fallback. hosted canary has no remote toggle.

ryan_c: pause and pin. we should avoid churn. what's TTL? suggest 3h to let infra investigate.

deploybot: action available: `pin-version --target=us-west-night-3 --version=2026-04-qx2-stable --ttl=3h`

marta_l: opsbot run quick smoke with seqlen 4096, 8192, 12288 on 3 nodes and collect mem/p95/ooms.

opsbot: queued: `ops smoke --bundle 2026-05-qx3-matmul-slab --nodes=3 --seqlens=4096,8192,12288 --dur=300 --collect=mem,p95,p99,ooms` ETA 6m.

opsbot: smoke complete: 4096 p95 +10% mem +6% no OOM; 8192 p95 +30% mem +22% 1 OOM; 12288 p95 +65% mem +55% 2 OOMs. logs: https://internal.run/smoke/1769990000

ryan_c: reproduces. pin now.

deploybot: executed: `pin-version --target=us-west-night-3 --version=2026-04-qx2-stable --ttl=3h --reason="OOMs at long tail seqlen on qx3"`

release-coordinator: good. next: (1) create debug build with slab reclaim off + early-free enabled, (2) run extended long-tail harness pre-roll, (3) add runtime flag for allocator-fallback in hosted builds. i'll open the ticket and add owners.

marta_l: posting a short internal note and a line for release-notes: "Paused limited canary for qx3 due to memory pressure on very long sequences; reverting to stable while we patch."

ryan_c: monitoring subscribed. opsbot alert if OOM >0 or p95 > baseline *1.25 for 10m.

opsbot: subscribed. will escalate to @oncall on alerts.
